name: dependency-security-remediation
title: Dependency Security Remediation
description: Apply compatible dependency security patches on main and document residual upstream findings.
creator: Ian
notes: Baseline 3f86df5. The branch pins postcss-selector-parser@7.1.6 and katex@0.18.7, and refreshes Astro's http-cache-semantics lock entry to 4.3.0. The full 143-test site suite and 112-page production build pass with that lock. The GHSA still lists no patched version; 4.3.0 still returns a hit for the disputed max-stale case, but KIRARI's static image build only calls storable/timeToLive and has no demonstrated inbound request path to it. CI run 39714987373 passed verify and both browser jobs on code HEAD fa1ef2b. The subsequent successful audit on docs-only HEAD d790cf2 reported zero findings. PR must remain unmerged until separate Production cutover authorization because merging main triggers native Vercel Production.
